payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. All deterministic checks pass (deterministic_findings is empty, omitted_artefacts is empty). Specific verifications: (1) loaded_split_sizes exactly match official_split_sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) with subsampled=false — no silent resampling. (2) n_classes=9 matches the 9-entry labels list. (3) n_channels=3 is correct for RGB PathMNIST. (4) Both manifests carry schema_version 1.0 and are internally consistent. (5) created_at (11:21:09.6) is ~1.5 s before the authoritative current_utc (11:21:11.1), which is expected. (6) Archive MD5 and per-split index SHA-256 hashes are present, enabling provenance verification. (7) Package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, numpy 2.4.6, scikit-learn 1.9.0, Python 3.11.15) are mutually compatible and plausible for the 2026 timeframe. Two minor observations (neither blocking): (a) llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, so exact weight provenance cannot be independently verified — this is a reproducibility gap worth tracking but not an ingestion error; (b) the test-domain note confirms the test split originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K), a known PathMNIST characteristic that should be carried into downstream evaluation interpretation. No issues require revision; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weight provenance is not pinned, limiting full reproducibility of any LLM-assisted steps.

Test split (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center than train/val; this domain shift is a known PathMNIST property but must be explicitly accounted for in any downstream performance reporting.
